standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Flatness, the lemma listing the three conditions (Zariski glueing, descent along surjective flat proper finitely presented morphisms, and the modification condition) that imply that a category fibred in groupoids over the h-site is a stack

core_obligations: Check condition (1) (proof lines 23266-23271): Zariski coverings are etale coverings, so glueing for sheaves applies.

Check condition (2) (proof lines 23273-23278): for a surjective, flat and proper morphism of finite presentation over S with affine target one has descent for the cover, by either of the two descent lemmas for etale sheaves.
Check condition (3) (proof lines 23280-23281): the modification condition follows immediately from the more general glueing lemma for modifications of etale sheaves.
Conclude (proof lines 23283-23284): the cited criterion for h-stacks then shows that the category fibred in groupoids of etale sheaves is a stack in groupoids over the h-site.
proof_roadmap: Verify the three conditions of the criterion for h-stacks, quoting the corresponding descent results for etale sheaves.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a scheme S the category fibred in groupoids over the h-site whose fibre over U is the category of sheaves on the small etale site of U is a stack in groupoids (statement lines 23256-23264). The proof (proof lines 23266-23285) checks the three conditions of the criterion for h-stacks: Zariski glueing, descent along a surjective flat proper finitely presented cover, and the modification condition. H2: three verifications, each written out with its input.
